notes: Scribe statement is Newari: 'liṣitiṃ vidyāpīṭhayā karmmācārya jayasiṃha' = written by Jayasiṃha, karmācārya of (the) Vidyāpīṭha; Vidyāpīṭha taken as his institution/residence, not as place of copying. Catalogue 'Jayasiṃkarmmācārya' agrees. The ownership note on line 4 ('eyācchayā vipraśrīgaṃgā[dha]rarājasya (!) pustakam idaṃ') is probably a separate, possibly later entry; 'eyācchayā' is unclear (Newari word or place?), 'dha' is restored, and '-rāja' may be part of the name (Gaṅgādhararāja) or a title; cataloguer marks it (!). Gaṅgādhara listed as owner with medium confidence. 'mārggaśila' = Mārgaśira/Mārgaśīrṣa. NS 799 Mārgaśīrṣa ≈ Nov–Dec 1678 CE.
